cards.title: Managing the mental load in partnerships
cards.body: Research shows mothers often carry disproportionate responsibility for planning, organizing, and remembering household tasks. Couples can share this burden more equitably with clear communication and delegation strategies.

cards.title: Navigating crushes while married with children
cards.body: A parent seeks advice about romantic feelings for their child's teacher. The column explores how crushes can feel liberating but offers perspective on whether acting on them serves your family's wellbeing.

cards.title: Maternity care access and safety concerns
cards.body: A pregnant mother reflects on Ireland's two-tier maternity system and the importance of affordable, accessible care. She advocates for universal state provision over private healthcare barriers.

cards.title: Children's knowledge quiz with kid-created questions
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions written by children test your general knowledge on topics like animal biology and physics. Parents and kids can enjoy this fun brain-teaser together.
